file_info.description: Mode 3: Create standardized master face image from a user portrait

prompts.Command: Create a realistic studio portrait master image of the same person shown in [PERSON_IMG].

Facial Consistency: PRECISELY ANALYZE AND MAP the unique facial geometry, bone structure, interpupillary distance (spacing between eyes), eye shape, nose bridge alignment, and jawline definition from [PERSON_IMG].
REPLICATE these exact features with absolute fidelity in the output master image.
Maintain all distinctive landmarks like specific skin texture patterns, moles, freckles, or subtle natural asymmetry present in the source image to ensure a perfect likeness.
Pose: PERFECTLY FRONT-FACING POSTURE. Head, torso, and BOTH shoulders must be completely square and parallel to the camera. Looking straight ahead directly into the lens.
No tilting of the head, no twisting of the body or shoulders.
Lighting: Soft, even, professional studio lighting. Flat lighting designed to clearly reveal facial topography without harsh shadows.
Expression: Neutral expression, mouth closed, relaxed facial features.
Framing: Head and shoulders shot (passport photo style cropping).
Clothing: Wearing a simple, neutral-colored plain t-shirt (to avoid distraction from facial features).
Quality: Ultra-realistic, 8k resolution, clean digital photography style, sharp focus on the eyes and facial details, detailed skin pores and texture clearly visible, no noise or grain.
